brief:
Three Palestinians were killed in Israeli shelling and gunfire across Gaza, the Shehab Wire reported. Several others were wounded in the attacks, which occurred as ceasefire violations persisted across multiple areas of the territory.

The killings marked the latest in a series of incidents since the ceasefire agreement took effect, with Israeli forces continuing operations in several locations throughout the enclave.

title: Israeli strikes kill three in Gaza as ceasefire violations continue
